name: reindent
description: The skills the Reindent studio runs on every day: boards, chat, browser. Extracted from daily production use by an agent workforce.

plugins.name: boards
plugins.description: Repo-native project boards that update themselves as you prompt to code: plain markdown files are the single source of truth, rendered by a ~70-line dependency-free parser in your own app, and every change lands in the same commit as the code. No external tool, CLI, SaaS, or database.

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Two agents, one shared file, until they agree. A file-based agent-to-agent conversation protocol: agents take turns modifying one shared markdown canvas toward consensus, with a live web view the user gets the moment the session opens. Works across different agent CLIs.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Give your agents a real, headed Chromium or Chrome driven over the DevTools Protocol: persistent logged-in profiles, safe clicking, React-proof typing, screenshots, SPA waiting — with a bundled zero-dependency CDP driver or Microsoft's Playwright MCP server, under a strict one-agent-one-session law.
